from pathlib import Path
import re, ast

path = Path("src/main.py")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")

# Remplace toute affectation notes cassee par version safe
text2, n1 = re.subn(
    r'setattr\(\s*p\s*,\s*k\s*,\s*str\(getattr\(\s*p\s*,\s*"notes"\s*\)\)\s*\+\s*f"[\s\S]*?(?=\n\s*(?:updated\.append|db\.commit|p\.updated_at|return\s|except\s|for\s|if\s|setattr\s|\Z))',
    'setattr(p, k, (str(getattr(p, "notes", None) or "") + "\\n[" + datetime.utcnow().isoformat()[:10] + "] " + str(v)).strip())\n            ',
    text,
    count=10,
)
text = text2
print("bloc notes re.sub:", n1)

# Fixes ligne par ligne des patterns connus
replacements = [
    ('setattr(p, k, str(getattr(p, "notes")) + f"',
     'setattr(p, k, (str(getattr(p, "notes", None) or "") + "\\n[" + datetime.utcnow().isoformat()[:10] + "] " + str(v)).strip())  # FIXNOTES'),
    ("setattr(p, k, str(getattr(p, 'notes')) + f'",
     "setattr(p, k, (str(getattr(p, 'notes', None) or '') + '\\n[' + datetime.utcnow().isoformat()[:10] + '] ' + str(v)).strip())  # FIXNOTES"),
    ('str(getattr(p, "notes")) + f"',
     '(str(getattr(p, "notes", None) or "") + "\\n[" + datetime.utcnow().isoformat()[:10] + "] " + str(v)).strip()  # FIXNOTES; _old="'),
]
for a,b in replacements:
    if a in text:
        text = text.replace(a,b)
        print("replaced:", a[:40])

# Nettoyer debris apres FIXNOTES (reste de f-string casse sur lignes suivantes)
lines = text.splitlines(True)
out = []
i = 0
while i < len(lines):
    line = lines[i]
    if "# FIXNOTES" in line:
        out.append(line)
        i += 1
        # sauter lignes debris jusqu'a une ligne Python saine
        while i < len(lines):
            s = lines[i].strip()
            if not s:
                i += 1
                break
            # debris typiques d'un f-string coupe
            if (
                s.startswith(")")
                or s.startswith("updated.append")
                or s.startswith("p.updated_at")
                or s.startswith("db.commit")
                or s.startswith("return")
                or s.startswith("for ")
                or s.startswith("if ")
                or s.startswith("setattr")
                or s.startswith("valid")
                or s.startswith("try")
                or s.startswith("except")
                or s.startswith("log_activity")
                or s.startswith("#")
                or re.match(r"^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s*=", s)
                or s.startswith("def ")
                or s.startswith("class ")
                or s.startswith("@")
            ):
                # on garde cette ligne saine
                break
            # sinon c'est du debris de string -> skip
            print("skip debris:", s[:60])
            i += 1
        continue
    out.append(line)
    i += 1
text = "".join(out)

# Fix autre cas: notes = ... f" casse
text = re.sub(
    r'notes\s*=\s*\(\(p\.notes or ""\) \+ f"[\s\S]*?\)\.strip\(\)',
    'notes = ((p.notes or "") + "\\n[" + datetime.utcnow().isoformat()[:10] + "] " + str(notes) ).strip()',
    text,
    count=5,
)

path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
b = path.read_bytes()
if b.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
    path.write_bytes(b[3:])

ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
print("SYNTAXE OK")

CLEAN_REPLY_SAFE = """def clean_agent_reply(text_in: str) -> str:
    if not text_in:
        return "Bonjour ! Comment puis-je t'aider pour ta prospection aujourd'hui ?"
    t = str(text_in).replace("\\r\\n", "\\n").strip()
    if not t:
        return "Bonjour ! Comment puis-je t'aider pour ta prospection aujourd'hui ?"

    # Supprimer les blocs JSON bruts
    t = re.sub(r"```(?:json)?[\s\S]*?```", "", t).strip()
    t = re.sub(r"\\{\\s*\"tool\"[\\s\\S]*?\\}\\s*$", "", t).strip()

    bad_starts = (
        "user identity", "user:", "user message", "role:", "capabilities:",
        "i should", "the user said", "step 1", "step 2", "tools available",
        "if i want", "actually,", "wait,", "note:", "let's", "lets ",
        "is it json", "does it follow", "analysis", "plan:", "placeholder"
    )

    kept = []
    for line in t.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        sl = s.lower()
        if not s:
            if kept:
                kept.append("")
            continue
        if s.startswith("*") and any(k in sl for k in ["user", "role", "tool", "should", "step"]):
            continue
        if any(sl.startswith(b) for b in bad_starts):
            continue
        kept.append(line)

    out = "\\n".join(kept).strip()
    out = re.sub(r"\\n{3,}", "\\n\\n", out).strip()

    if not out or len(out.strip()) < 2:
        out = str(text_in).strip()

    return out if out else "Bonjour ! Comment puis-je t'aider aujourd'hui ?" """

if "def clean_agent_reply" in code:
    code = re.sub(
        r"def clean_agent_reply[\s\S]*?(?=\ndef [a-zA-Z_])",
        CLEAN_REPLY_SAFE + "\n\n",
        code,
        count=1
    )

# 3. RÃ©Ã©criture de la fonction addMsg et sendMsg cÃ´tÃ© Frontend pour garantir le rendu visuel
JS_FIX = """
        function addMsg(role, text, meta) {
            var box = document.getElementById('messages');
            if (!box) return;
            var d = document.createElement('div');
            d.className = 'msg ' + (role === 'user' ? 'msg-user' : 'msg-agent');
            d.style.padding = '10px 14px';
            d.style.borderRadius = '10px';

            d.style.fontSize = '14px';
            d.style.lineHeight = '1.5';
            d.style.whiteSpace = 'pre-wrap';
            d.style.wordBreak = 'break-word';

            if (role === 'user') {
                d.style.background = '#0284c7';
                d.style.color = '#ffffff';
                d.style.marginLeft = 'auto';
                d.style.maxWidth = '80%';
            } else {
                d.style.background = '#1e293b';
                d.style.color = '#f8fafc';

                d.style.marginRight = 'auto';
                d.style.maxWidth = '85%';
            }

            d.textContent = text || '(reponse vide)';
            if (meta) {
                var m = document.createElement('div');
                m.style.fontSize = '10px';
                m.style.color = '#94a3b8';
                m.style.marginTop = '4px';
                m.textContent = meta;
                d.appendChild(m);
            }
            box.appendChild(d);
            box.scrollTop = box.scrollHeight;
        }

        async function sendMsg(msg) {
            if (!msg || !String(msg).trim()) return;
            msg = String(msg).trim();

            // Activer l'onglet chat si besoin
            try {
                var tabChat = document.getElementById('tab-chat');
                if (tabChat && !tabChat.classList.contains('active')) {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
                    document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
                    tabChat.classList.add('active');
                    var bChat = document.querySelector('.tab-btn');
                    if (bChat) bChat.classList.add('active');
                }
            } catch(e) {}

            // Afficher IMMÃ‰DIATEMENT le message utilisateur
            addMsg('user', msg);

            var input = document.getElementById('prompt');
            var btn = document.querySelector('#chat-form button') || document.getElementById('send');
            if (input) input.value = '';
            if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = '...'; }

            try {
                var r = await fetch('/api/chat', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ message: msg, session_id: sessionId })
                });
                var d = await r.json();
                var replyText = d.reply || d.answer || d.error || 'Aucune rÃ©ponse du serveur.';
                addMsg('agent', replyText, 'engine=' + (d.engine || 'gemini') + (d.model ? (' Â· ' + d.model) : ''));
            } catch(e) {
                addMsg('agent', 'Erreur de connexion au serveur : ' + e.message);
            } finally {
                if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Envoyer'; }
                if (typeof loadStats === 'function') loadStats();
                if (typeof loadHealth === 'function') loadHealth();
                if (typeof loadActivities === 'function') loadActivities();
            }
        }
"""

if "function addMsg(role, text, meta)" in code:
    code = re.sub(
        r"function addMsg\(role, text, meta\)[\s\S]*?async function sendMsg\(msg\)[\s\S]*?finally \{[\s\S]*?\}",
        JS_FIX.strip(),
        code,
        count=1
    )

main_path.write_text(code, encoding="utf-8")

# Nettoyage BOM
b = main_path.read_bytes()
if b.startswith(b"\xef\xbb\xbf"):
    main_path.write_bytes(b[3:])

# VÃ©rification AST obligatoire
try:
    ast.parse(main_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print("--> SYNTAXE PYTHON VALIDÃ‰E Ã€ 100% !")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"--> ERREUR AST SYNTAXE: {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

import os
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker, declarative_base
from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String

Base = declarative_base()

class Prospect(Base):
    __tablename__ = "prospects"
    id      = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    name    = Column(String)
    email   = Column(String, unique=True)
    company = Column(String)
    status  = Column(String, default="nouveau")

database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine  = create_engine(database_url)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db      = Session()

prospects = [

try:

        exists = db.query(Prospect).filter_by(email=email).first()
        if not exists:

import os, time
import google.generativeai as genai

key = (os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_API_KEY") or "").strip()
print("KEY:", bool(key), "len=", len(key))
if not key:
    raise SystemExit("Pas de cle")

genai.configure(api_key=key)

print("\n=== MODELES generateContent ===")
usable = []
try:
    for m in genai.list_models():
        methods = list(getattr(m, "supported_generation_methods", []) or [])
        if "generateContent" in methods:
            name = (getattr(m, "name", "") or "").replace("models/", "")
            usable.append(name)
            print(" -", name)
except Exception as e:
    print("list_models error:", e)

# modeles free a tester (ordre de preference)
candidates = [
    "gemini-2.0-flash-lite",
    "gemini-2.0-flash",
    "gemini-1.5-flash",
    "gemini-1.5-flash-8b",
    "gemini-1.5-flash-latest",
    "gemini-1.5-pro",
    "gemma-3-4b-it",
    "gemma-3-12b-it",
    "gemma-3-27b-it",
]
for u in usable:
    if u not in candidates:
        candidates.append(u)

print("\n=== TEST FREE MODELS ===")
ok = []
for name in candidates:
    # eviter les alias souvent sature
    if name in {"gemini-flash-latest", "gemini-pro", "gemini-3.8-flash"}:
        print("SKIP", name)
        continue
    try:
        model = genai.GenerativeModel(name)
        r = model.generate_content("Dis seulement: OK")
        t = (getattr(r, "text", None) or "").strip()
        if t:
            print("SUCCESS", name, "->", t[:40])
            ok.append(name)
            # petite pause anti-quota
            time.sleep(2)
            if len(ok) >= 5:
                break
        else:
            print("EMPTY", name)
    except Exception as e:
        msg = str(e)
        if "429" in msg:
            print("QUOTA", name)
        else:
            print("FAIL", name, "->", msg[:120])
        time.sleep(1)

if not ok:
    print("\nAUCUN MODELE FREE DISPO MAINTENANT")
    print("=> attends 10-30 min, ou cree une NOUVELLE cle AI Studio gratuite")
else:
    print("\nBEST FREE =", ok[0])
    with open("free_models.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write("\n".join(ok))
    print("Sauve dans free_models.txt")

import os
import google.generativeai as genai

key = os.getenv('GEMINI_API_KEY') or os.getenv('GOOGLE_API_KEY')
print('Cle trouvee:', bool(key), '| len=', len(key or ''))
if not key:
    raise SystemExit('Pas de cle')

genai.configure(api_key=key)
models = [os.getenv('GEMINI_MODEL') or 'gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-2.0-flash', 'gemini-1.5-flash', 'gemini-1.5-pro', 'gemini-pro']
last_err = None
for name in models:
    try:
        m = genai.GenerativeModel(name)
        r = m.generate_content('Reponds en une seule phrase courte: tu fonctionnes oui ou non?')
        print('OK modele:', name)
        print('Reponse :', (r.text or '').strip())
        break
    except Exception as e:
        last_err = e
        print('FAIL', name, '->', str(e)[:200])
else:
    print('AUCUN MODELE OK')
    raise SystemExit(last_err)

import sys
import asyncio
sys.path.insert(0, 'src')

from modules.prospect_finder import prospect_finder
from modules.message_engine import message_engine
from modules.analytics import analytics
from database.connection import init_db
from database.repositories import ProspectRepository
from database.models import ProspectStatus
from config import config

print('\n')
print('🧪 TEST GROUPE 3: MODULES MÉTIER')
print('==================================\n')

print('1️⃣ Test ProspectFinder...')
async def test_finder():
    results = await prospect_finder.search_prospects({'limit': 3})
    assert len(results) > 0
    print(f'   ✓ {len(results)} prospects trouvés')
    return results

results = asyncio.run(test_finder())

print('2️⃣ Test enrichissement...')
async def test_enrich():
    prospect_data = results[0]
    enriched = await prospect_finder.enrich_prospect(prospect_data)
    assert enriched is not None
    assert 'first_name' in enriched
    assert 'qualification_score' in enriched
    score = enriched['qualification_score']
    print(f'   ✓ Prospect enrichi (score: {score}/100)')

asyncio.run(test_enrich())

print('3️⃣ Test MessageEngine...')
db = init_db(config.DATABASE_URL)
session = db.get_session()
repo = ProspectRepository(session)
prospect = repo.get_all(limit=1)[0] if repo.count() > 0 else None

if prospect:
    message = message_engine.generate_personalized_message(
        prospect=prospect,
        pain_points=['Acquisition difficile'],
        solution='Notre plateforme IA',
        tone='professionnel'
    )
    assert message is not None
    print(f'   ✓ Message généré ({len(message)} caractères)')
    
    quality = message_engine.analyze_message_quality(message)
    print(f'   ✓ Qualité: {quality["quality_score"]}/100')
else:
    print('   ⚠️ Pas de prospect en BD')

db.close_session(session)

print('4️⃣ Test Analytics...')
db = init_db(config.DATABASE_URL)
stats = analytics.get_dashboard_stats(db, ProspectRepository, ProspectStatus)
assert 'total_prospects' in stats
print(f'   ✓ Stats: {stats}')

print()
print('✅ GROUPE 3 RÉUSSI - MODULES MÉTIER 100% OPÉRATIONNELS!')
print()

import os
from pathlib import Path
for line in Path('.env').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig').splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#') or '=' not in line: continue
    k,v=line.split('=',1)
    os.environ[k.strip()]=v.strip().strip('"').strip("'")

from src import main as m
if hasattr(m, "generate_with_rotation"):
    txt, used, err = m.generate_with_rotation("Reponds un mot: OK")
    print("--> MODEL ROTATOR OK! Modele utilise:", used)
    print("--> Reponse:", txt)
else:
